content: लब्ध {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [लभ्-कर्मणि-क्त] .²1 Got, obtained, acquired. .²2 Taken, received. .²3 Perceived, apprehended. .²4 Obtained, (as by division <ab>&c.</ab>); see लभ्. .{@-ब्धा@} A woman whose husband or lover is faithless (perhaps for विप्रलब्धा). .{@-ब्धम्@} .²1 That which is secured or got; लब्धं रक्षेदवक्षयात् <ls>H. 2. 8</ls>; <ls>R. 19. 3</ls>. .²2 A profit, gain; लब्धाच्च सप्तमं भागं तथा शृङ्गे कला खुरे <ls>Mb. 12. 60. 25</ls>.
